name: carry-estate-waits
what: The estate's page on the tour's Wed Mar 27 (ADR 0025 §6, second step): the day is Evidence feeds' to decide, and the sheet's head links to the page the site has for that flow

.vf-detail .vf-whose: Evidence feeds’ to decide: access_reviews holds. Larkspur estate waits on it.

name: carry-estate-flow
what: The flow's sheet on the estate's page: its own page is a tap away, beside the way into it and its month

name: carry-feeds-month
what: Evidence feeds' own page opens on its own month: the tour's two months as far as they are this flow's, the same days held by the same files, one still waiting

name: carry-feeds-about
what: About this flow names the flow that reads it, a tap from its page, and says the day is decided once

#flow-pages: A paused day is decided once, at the flow that holds: decided on either page, it is carried to the other.

name: carry-feeds-unread
what: A file of Inventory's that only the estate reads: on this page no step reads it, and its Data tab says so

text: No step of this flow reads this file, so a run here doesn’t read it.

name: carry-feeds-ontology
what: Its Ontology page: the estate's ontology as far as it is about this flow's datasets; a type whose objects are a file no step here reads shows no count, and nothing fails

name: carry-feeds-held
what: Evidence feeds' own page, the same flow on the same files with a record of its own: the same day is held by the same file, its own to decide, and the sheet says the estate's page takes the decision from here

.vf-detail .vf-whose: Larkspur estate reads this flow: a decision made here is carried there.

name: carry-feeds-decides
what: Decided once, at its flow, on the flow's own page: published as is, with a reason; the receipt says the estate's page takes the decision, a tap away

#loads .vf-rc-taken: Carried to Larkspur estate’s page when the day runs there.

name: carry-estate-carried
what: Back on the estate's page, the day runs, holds, and takes the decision made on Evidence feeds' page: published as is, nobody asked, and the receipt says where it was decided

#loads .vf-rc-carried: Decided on Evidence feeds’ page, and carried here: nobody was asked twice.

name: carry-estate-record
what: The estate's record: the file's decision is Evidence feeds', carried from its page and citing its entry there; the posture's own load carries that one, as inside one page

#record: carried from Evidence feeds’ page, its #

name: carry-estate-month
what: The month's day picked tells it in order: held, then decided on Evidence feeds' page and carried here

#view-month .mo-sum: On Evidence feeds’ page, Owner published it as is. Carried here.

name: carry-estate-again
what: The estate's page opened again: the day runs in a new engine, holds, and the decision it carried is applied again from its own record, as any decision is; the other page isn't asked twice either

#loads .vf-rc-carried: Decided on Evidence feeds’ page, and carried here: nobody was asked twice.

name: carry-estate-audit
what: The estate's record exported for audit: the bag carries the proof of the decision it cites, and the offline audit holds it without Evidence feeds' record

name: carry-back-decides
what: The other way, in a fresh browser: the estate's page decides the day at Evidence feeds, where its file holds: not published

#loads .vf-rc-taken: Carried to Evidence feeds’ page when the day runs there.

name: carry-back-carried
what: Evidence feeds' own page takes it: the decision was its flow's, made on the estate's page, so its own page asks nobody; the receipt says where it was decided, by whom

#loads .vf-rc-carried: Decided on Larkspur estate’s page, and carried here: nobody was asked twice.

name: carry-back-record
what: Evidence feeds' record cites the estate's entry

#record: carried from Larkspur estate’s page, its #

name: carry-back-amends
what: The decision is changed on the flow's own page: published as is after all, with a reason, amending the one it carried

name: carry-back-amended
what: The estate's page carries the change in turn: the flow's latest decision stands on both pages, its own earlier one amended

#loads .vf-rc-carried: Decided on Evidence feeds’ page, and carried here: nobody was asked twice.

name: carry-back-audit
what: Evidence feeds' record exported for audit: each decision of its own flow says the flow as kept, the one carried from the estate's page is proved from the estate's record, and the offline audit holds the bag

name: carry-rules-edit
what: A third browser: on Evidence feeds' own page the owner handles a column the estate describes its own way, so the flow there is no longer the flow the estate reads
clicks: The feed names the authority, not the certificate’s issuer field

name: carry-rules-decides
what: The day decided there, under the rules as they are there

name: carry-rules-not-carried
what: The estate's page doesn't take it: the decision was made at a flow whose rules differ, by its hash. The day still waits here, and the sheet says what was decided there and why it isn't carried

.vf-detail .vf-not-carried: Decided on Evidence feeds’ page, where Evidence feeds isn’t as it is here: its rules differ, so that decision isn’t carried. Decide it here.

name: carry-fill-staged
what: A fourth browser: on Evidence feeds' own page the day is to be filled from the day before; the fill is staged, and nothing is out yet

name: carry-fill-decides
what: Filled from Tue 26 there; the receipt says the estate's page takes it

#loads .vf-rc-taken: Carried to Larkspur estate’s page when the day runs there.

name: carry-fill-carried
what: The estate's page takes the fill: the same remedy, made here from this page's own offer of it (the same file of the same day, judged from this page's history), staged on its own run and published; the posture's own load is decided with the file's

#loads .vf-rc-carried: Decided on Evidence feeds’ page, and carried here: nobody was asked twice.

name: carry-fill-record
what: The estate's record: the fill's decision carried from Evidence feeds' page, its derived run made here, and its release

#record: carried from Evidence feeds’ page, its #

name: carry-fill-audit
what: The estate's bag with a carried fill, held by the offline audit: the file's decision, the load that follows it, and the release of the derived run citing the file's

name: carry-fill-again
what: Opened again, in a new engine: the fill is made again from the decision as this record keeps it, and released again

name: carry-fill-again-audit
what: The bag again, from the new engine, which no longer holds its own judgement of the first fill's donor: the audit goes by the repair as recorded, told from this page's history

name: carry-fill-withdrawn
what: The fill is taken back on the flow's own page: readers see the day before again

name: carry-fill-withdrawn-carried
what: The estate's page takes that in turn: the decision not to publish amends the fill it had carried, and the day isn't published here either

#loads: Decided on Evidence feeds’ page, and carried here: nobody was asked twice.
